ns2:course.label: Erosion and Sediment Control
ns2:course.description: Processes, estimation, and control of soil erosion by water, wind and resultant sedimentation. Upland, in-channel, urban, agricultural, disturbed (both military training and mining), and forested environments. Capstone experience in site planning and design. Prerequisite: CEE 350 or NRES 401; CEE 380 or NRES 201.
